mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing supply chain disruptions (INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually), S&P 500 forward returns become negative over the next 20 days due to inflationary pressures and reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth is below 0.5% annually.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 6 months indicates strengthening consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST has increased for 6 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 5.0%, it triggers a hawkish monetary policy response that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal a severe labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recession probability increases.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), S&P 500 forward returns become negative over the next 60 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced corporate borrowing.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.
